texts: Aortic dissection presents at a younger age in men than in women: B.
It is about twice as common in men, and women come later in life and often with less typical symptoms: the two young men ahead, the old woman behind.
It is more frequent in winter and in the morning hours, not in summer or at night: the snow and the rising sun.
Penetrating ulcers mostly involve the descending aorta, not the ascending.
Memory hook: two young men run ahead in the winter dawn; the old woman follows.
